description: This Java class 'JWTGenerator' provides functionality to generate and sign JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) using different cryptographic algorithms and key pairs. It includes methods for creating JWTs with standard claims and signing them with appropriate algorithms.

classes.name: JWTGenerator
classes.description: A class for generating and signing JWT tokens with various cryptographic algorithms.

methods.name: generateJWT
methods.description: Generates a JWT with standard claims such as subject, audience, issuer, and timestamps, signed with RS256 algorithm.

methods.name: signJWT
methods.description: Signs a JWT with custom claims using specified asymmetric key algorithms.
